card.name: Leading digit starting a number
card.fires_on: The first digit, usually 1 or 2, of a multi-digit number that follows a comma or opening parenthesis. It shows up in statistics, years, counts and section references.

modes.label: Statistic after comma
modes.description: A leading 1 or 2 begins a count or percentage right after a clause ending in a comma.
